metadata.note: Manually curated from the official GA SoS election calendar. "status" (upcoming/completed) is computed client-side from the current date, not stored here. Per-election dates are verifiable on the SoS My Voter Page election-details view (mvp.sos.ga.gov → Election Details and Calendar); the Aug 25 special runoff was confirmed there on 2026-08-17.

elections.name: General Primary Election Runoff
elections.earlyVotingNote: No later than 06/08/26 – 06/12/26 (exact dates set by county)

elections.name: Special Election — U.S. House District 13
elections.earlyVotingNote: No later than 07/20/26 – 07/24/26 (exact dates set by county)
elections.contingentNote: Only U.S. House District 13 voters — Rockdale County and parts of Clayton, DeKalb, Gwinnett, Henry, and Newton Counties. No candidate cleared 50 percent, so the top two advanced to an August 25 runoff.

elections.name: Special Election Runoff — U.S. House District 13
elections.earlyVotingNote: End date set by county (state law requires advance voting through the Friday before Election Day)
elections.contingentNote: Only U.S. House District 13 voters — Rockdale County and parts of Clayton, DeKalb, Gwinnett, Henry, and Newton Counties. Runoff between Marcye Scott and Everton "EJ" Blair to fill the seat left vacant by Rep. David Scott.

elections.name: General Election / Special Election Runoff
elections.earlyVotingNote: End date set by county — the advance voting week is shortened by the Thanksgiving holiday
elections.contingentNote: Only held if a statewide runoff is required from the November 3 General Election.
